provenance.construction: Open-boundary weight-8 tile code (B=5 box): boundary_engine.build_planar(20, 20, S_f=[[0, 0], [1, 3], [4, 0], [4, 4]], S_g=[[0, 4], [2, 1], [3, 2], [4, 0]]) followed by reduce_weights, all-zero rows dropped; bilayer layout planar.grid_coordinates (A and B qubits of cell (i,j) at site (i,j) on two layers). Supports found by mutation search over 4+4 monomials in a 5x5 box. Tile-code family of arXiv:2504.09171; this support pair and lattice size are not taken from that paper.
provenance.notes: Equivalence checked: the gate's dedup step found no exact duplicate and no WL-equivalent board entry (checked, not equivalent). Distance is an RIS upper bound: the X witness of weight 22 was found at 1M trials (seed 101, pair depth 64) and nothing lighter appeared in 6M further trials on seeds 102/201.
